android.desc:
The Ultimate Senior Launcher for Effortless Smartphone Enjoyment

A smartphone launcher designed for older adults does not need to be boring. We have created ONYPhone for older adults with a stylish and intuitive interface. We strive to present technology that empowers older adults to enjoy using their smartphones. And what's more, we offer a 7-day free trial, allowing you to explore all the features without any commitment or the need to sign up.

⭐️⭐️⭐️ INTRODUCING ONYPHONE

This is ONYPhone, a beautiful smartphone interface designed for seniors. If you find the current Android phone's interface confusing and frustrating, ONY can help. ONY interface has bigger icons and text to make a phone easy to use. It is super convenient to navigate and find your favorite apps, turn on WiFi, Bluetooth, and other settings, add new apps, or even uninstall them. We have identified the most common actions seniors perform on their phones and made them intuitive and fuss-free.

Your favorite apps are just one touch away from our simplified clutter-free home screen. Simply add your most-used apps on the home screen and quickly access them, avoiding the need to scroll too much. You can even arrange the order in which your apps appear. Moreover, if you need to access all the apps, you can find them in one place with bigger icons.

Adjusting volume or brightness is effortless, and you can do so by tapping on the big + or - icons. All the basic settings, like torchlight, WiFi, Bluetooth, Flight mode, and more, are readily available, and you do not need to go through layers and layers of menu selections.

🌟🌟🌟 FEATURES
🆕 📞 ONY Call - a simple, senior‑friendly dialer with big buttons and clear feedback for easy one‑tap calling.
🟢 Simplified, beautiful home screen for easy access to favorite apps.
🟢 Easy access to the standard system settings.
🟢 AIR mode for those who need the bare basic functionality with everything else hidden.
🟢 All the app management simplified:
    ✅ Add or remove apps to home screen
    ✅ Arrange apps on home screen
    ✅ Rename apps
    ✅ Hide unwanted apps
    ✅ Uninstall apps
🟢 No Ads ever! 
🟢 Virtual home button, app notifications, personalized themes, and many more.

🚩🚩🚩 IMPORTANT
➡️ You can start a 7-day FREE trial before purchasing. No signups are required.
➡️ We highly encourage you to use the 7-day trial period to install and test the launcher on your Android phone before buying the license. 
➡️ Some features may not work

quotes.text:
Hi all,

Hello from team SilverActivities, a Singapore-based company that develops digital activities and apps for older adults.

We launched the ONY Phone Android launcher a few months ago. After engaging with many seniors and seeing them struggle with using modern tech interfaces, we decided to develop our version of the Android launcher for older adults. We found many such apps on the Play store, but they were all made when smartphones came out and looked sad and boring.

A smartphone launcher designed for older adults does not need to be boring. We aim to present technology that empowers older adults to enjoy using their smartphones. We have created this app for older adults with a stylish and intuitive interface. So, if your elderly loved ones find the current Android phone's interface confusing and frustrating, the ONY app can help.

We hope you will give it a try. We value your feedback and look forward to updating the apps with necessary and useful features.
